displayName: DiamondEcho SRE: API pinned at its maximum of 3 instances

documentation.subject: DiamondEcho: the API has no room left to grow
documentation.content:
For 5 minutes one API revision has had 3 active instances, the maximum it is allowed (deploy/cloud-run.service.yaml). Each instance takes one request at a time (concurrency 1), so a fourth visitor waits and may be refused. That is either real demand or something slow holding instances.

What to do: follow docs/sre/runbooks/api-slow-or-saturated.md. If it looks like abuse, docs/sre/runbooks/traffic-spike-or-abuse.md. Raising the maximum costs money and is Gbenga's decision.

This message carries no visitor data.

conditions.displayName: 3 active instances on one revision for 5 minutes
